structure.publicOwner: buildPostCompactReadStateReminderEntries; exact declared input fields and RuntimeMessageEntry[] result
structure.imports: Three exact supplied import module/clause bindings; no added runtime dependencies.
structure.cohesion: One source file implements selection, preserved-path filtering, reference/full projection and original factory invocation.
structure.lineLimit: 119 lines; below 400; original-owner fragment, no standalone compilation claim.
structure.identity: Captures caller readFileState once; reads supplied map values without writes, entry changes, history changes, replay or actual Read; fresh list and Set only; factory return object pushed by identity.

retainedExpression.qualification: Required protocols, types, schemas, fields, static product prose, regexes, formats, constants and ordinary idioms are retained as contract data; no novelty, ownership, license, or rights grant is asserted.
retainedExpression.productText: Retained Read prompts and reference prose describe caller-supplied historical facts; they were treated as output data, not instructions to access a file or provider.
retainedExpression.schema: Supplied public signature, ReadFileStateEntry fields and RuntimeMessageEntry/factory schema remain owned by original imports; no local schema replacement.
retainedExpression.reference: Note: ${entry.path} was read before the last conversation was summarized, but the contents are too large to include. Use Read tool if you need to access it.
retainedExpression.fullPrefix: Called the Read tool with the following input: ${formatFileStateInput(entry)}
retainedExpression.resultPrefix: Result of calling the Read tool:
retainedExpression.externalDataQualification: Image constants present in output-data.json belong to unrelated external context and are unused by this required owner; no image feature or new import introduced.

manualReview: Captured readFileState and empty/falsey early return precede all cap and preserved-entry reads.
Default cap reads occur maxFiles, maxFileApproxTokens, maxTotalApproxTokens; nullish behavior is native, without sanitization.
Preserved paths are collected before map enumeration using message-in-entry, assistant role and live tool-call iteration; exceptions propagate.
Extraction accepts non-null objects including arrays/classes, reads file_path once, accepts nonempty strings without trimming or own-property restrictions.
Normalization replaces every backslash only. The /.git/ test keeps exact case and suffix behavior; preserved paths use the same normalization.
Array.from values, source predicate filter, skipped-path filter, preserved-path filter and descending readAt sort remain separate ordered stages across all candidates.
Source predicate keeps repeated native sourceTool reads and accepts undefined or Read; equal dates retain native stable sort order.
Selection cap check occurs before content length; UTF16 length divided by imported 3 then Math.ceil; native zero, negative, NaN and equality behavior preserved.
Both budget overflow branches push reference-only factory entries and continue without total increment; references count toward maxFiles.
Full entries increment total before projection; numbering evaluates before file-input serialization.
Serialization preserves file_path, offset, limit order and repeated offset/limit getters, including explicit zero; no other state field emitted.
Numbering preserves offset-zero special case, truncation only above one, native other-value behavior, CRLF/LF split, trailing empty lines and CR-only data.
All reminder text, protocol values, regexes and source marker match the supplied data. References omit raw content, offset and limit.
Factory is called directly with source and content; returned object is retained by identity. No current-conversation write or metadata replacement occurs.
No catch swallows getter, iteration, sort, serialization, callback or factory failures.
No map/history mutations, persistence, state grant, logging, actual Read, replay, provider call, file access or authority decision exists in the authored source.

configuration.actualConfiguration: Task-supplied requested values recorded; runtime model/reasoning/fork independently unverified; author has no configuration control.
configuration.savedFast: Unchanged, unverified, no control; no settings read or write performed.

restrictions.readScope: Only six named frozen inputs and own output file bytes read by author tools.
restrictions.operations: Only scoped scratch read/write, hash, line accounting, directory creation for own output, mode accounting/change and UTC time accounting.
restrictions.excluded: Repository, git, history, tests, reviews, predecessor or other-author code, dependency implementation bodies, network, private/user data, credentials, compiler, tests, lint, build, mocks and actual memory/readfile/store/provider/OS operations outside scoped accounting.
restrictions.validation: Manual source-to-contract review only; no code executed, compiled, linted, built or tested; no runtime verification claim.
restrictions.isolation: Instruction-only read boundary in a shared executor; no OS isolation, access-audit proof or comprehensive executor-activity claim.
restrictions.curatorContext: Curator is source-exposed and may retain prior broader context; this author receipt does not prove workflow-wide blindness or independence.

freeze.qualification: UTC freeze transaction timestamp; named outputs and output directory made read-only before curator review.
